[Rumor] Galaxy S27 Pro Nongol di Geekbench dengan Exynos 2700, Skor 3.061/10.967

The biggest change in the upcoming Galaxy S27 lineup is the inclusion of a new model called the Galaxy S27 Pro. While Samsung has not confirmed this moniker, it has already appeared in the IMEI database a couple of months ago. So, that means the lineup has four models, the S27, S27 Plus, S27 Pro, and S27 Ultra. The Pro is expected to sit between the Plus and the Ultra, bringing much of the Ultra’s hardware to a smaller phone without an S Pen. Rumors suggest that the S27 series will be announced in January 2027. Well before this, the S27 Pro has surfaced on Geekbench, revealing its key specifications. SCOOP: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro, Indian and European variant, spotted on Geekbench for the first time. 🇮🇳 Model SM-S957B Single-Core: 3061 Multi-Core: 10967 🔳 Chip: Samsung s5e9975, Exynos 2700 10 cores, up to 4.24GHz 💾 RAM: 12GB 🍭 OS: Android 17 🎮 GPU: Xclipse 970 pic.twitter.com/2FNd2vjGL0

Tipster Abhishek Yadav spotted the Galaxy S27 Pro on Geekbench for the first time. The listing is for model SM-S957B, the Indian and European variant. Samsung’s B suffix usually marks global or international models, including units sold in India and Europe. It identifies the chip as Samsung’s s5e9975, the Exynos 2700 , with 10 cores running at up to 4.24GHz and an Xclipse 970 GPU. The tested unit had 12GB of RAM, ran Android 17, and scored 3,061 in single-core and 10,967 in multi-core. The Galaxy S27 Pro is tipped to use a 6.47-inch M16 OLED panel with Privacy Display, in a smaller body than the Ultra and without an S Pen. Leaked CAD models also show a raised camera plateau similar to the one expected on the Ultra. For photography, it is rumored to pack a 200-megapixel main sensor, a 50-megapixel ultrawide, and a 16-megapixel front camera. The telephoto is less settled, with later reports citing a 12-megapixel 3x lens and earlier ones a 50-megapixel unit with around 3.5x zoom. TUV filings list the Pro’s cell at a 5,087mAh rated capacity and a 5,240mAh typical capacity, and China’s 3C certification points to 60W wired charging. Wireless and reverse wireless charging are also expected across the series. Earlier reports had already suggested a Snapdragon chip in some regions and the Exynos 2700 in others, which this global listing supports. For daily updates, please visit our News Section .
